routes.title: Snagem Guild: Pokemon Roleplay Community & Forum RPG
routes.description: Join Team Snagem, a free Pokemon roleplay community. Write your story on our forums, catch and battle Pokemon, breed, trade, and climb the gym ladder.

routes.title: About Team Snagem: A Pokemon Roleplay Guild
routes.description: Team Snagem is a long-running Pokemon roleplay guild. Learn our story, how snagging works, and how to join the pokemon roleplay adventure.

routes.title: News & Announcements | Snagem Guild
routes.description: The latest Snagem Guild news: new pokemon roleplay features, events, and everything shipping next for the community.

routes.title: The Library: Pokedex, Battle Guides & Lore | Snagem Guild
routes.description: The Snagem Guild reference wing: a full Pokedex with star ratings, battle and forum guides, shadow pokemon lore, and the guild FAQ.

routes.title: Community Rules & Policies | Snagem Guild
routes.description: House rules for the Snagem pokemon roleplay community: conduct, privacy, cookies, and terms of use.

routes.title: Pokemon Roleplay Missions | Snagem Guild
routes.description: Pick up a mission from the Snagem Vault: story briefs, set foes to battle, and coin rewards, all played out as forum roleplay.

routes.title: Gym Challenges & Island Trials | Snagem Guild
routes.description: Take on gym leaders region by region, clear island trials, and climb the rematch ladder in Snagem's pokemon roleplay challenges.

routes.title: The Colosseum: Pokemon Battles & Training | Snagem Guild
routes.description: Snagem's battle hub: rankings, tournaments, the Hall of Fame, and the Super Training Room for your pokemon roleplay team.

routes.title: Darts' Ghastly Gambling Casino | Snagem Guild
routes.description: Spin, roll, and chase the Shadow Lotto jackpot with Gengar Tokens at the Snagem Guild's in-universe casino.

routes.title: The Snag Mall: Pokemon Item Shops | Snagem Guild
routes.description: Storefronts for balls, medicine, held items, fishing rods and evolution gear, plus recycling and crafting, in the Snagem Guild mall.

routes.title: Weekly Activities: Snag List, Farm & Fishing | Snagem Guild
routes.description: Weekly pokemon roleplay activities: the Snag List checklist, the Berry Farm, and the once-a-week Fishing Pond.

routes.title: The Research Lab: Fossils & Progression | Snagem Guild
routes.description: Revive fossils, pursue Hybrid and Channeler progression, and request Master clearance at the Snagem Guild research lab.
